title: PostgreSQL TLS verification
summary: libpq verify-full checks certificate trust and the declared hostname. A listener accepting TCP does not establish that the database connection satisfies its TLS contract. Compare trust, hostname and server policy before attributing rejection to authentication.
checks: Rerun postgresql_connect with the declared hostname and explicitly allowlisted ca_file.
limitations: The driver may omit SQLSTATE; certificate contents and credential values are not retained.
